pageCache.text:
Thank you for visiting our website. Here you can learn a little more about our fantastic school.
At Eastbury Primary School we aim to provide a wonderful learning environment where all children can thrive and succeed. We have an excellent staff who are dedicated to ensuring they provide the best possible learning experiences and opportunities. We work hard to create a caring school in which every child can achieve whilst feeling safe and happy. Our children are polite, well mannered, enthusiastic learners who are supported by their parents and our local community. Feel free to explore our site and learn a little more about us. Better still, if you are a potential parent or member of our community, then please do come and meet us.
Lisa Shepherd, Headteacher
Our Values
At Eastbury, we nurture creativity, encouraging pupils to explore new ideas, express themselves with confidence, and think imaginatively. We inspire our children to keep aiming high, setting ambitious goals and striving to achieve their very best in everything they do. We foster a love of learning through enjoyment, creating a happy, engaging environment where curiosity thrives. We promote respect, teaching children to value themselves, others, and the world around them. Above all, we build resilience, helping children to persevere, learn from challenges, and grow stronger with every experience. Together, these values guide our school community and support every child on their journey to success.

Governors and Partnership Learning
Governors
At Eastbury Primary School, we have a Local Governing Board (LGB) to which our academy trust, Partnership Learning, delegates wide-ranging powers and responsibilities. These powers and responsibilities are set out in the Partnership Learning Scheme of Overall Delegation – see below.
The Local Governors are responsible for the strategic oversight of the school and delegate the day-to-day running of the school to the Headteachers.
Local Governors also sit on The Performance and Standards Committee which is chaired by Dr Zaheer Ahmed MBE
Here we have listed all members of our Local Governing Board and any committees on which they sit.

Road Safety – Parent
Welcome to our Road Safety Page
We need to work together to ensure our children are safe when arriving and leaving the school. Make sure you drive slowly and carefully on the road around the school, park your car where you are allowed to park and follow the expected speed limit.
Lots of the children come to school by themselves working towards being independent for the next stage in their life, moving onto Secondary School. Please show your awareness by following simple steps to being a safer driver.
Click on the Brake logo to go to the site for support.
Road safety is essential for us all to stay safe. This page gives key information on how we can keep our families safe.

What our parents say about Eastbury Primary School
Please take a moment to find out what our parents think of Eastbury Primary School
“The school has an open door policy. I am able to speak with the team on any issues and they are quick to offer solutions”
“It really supports all aspects of learning, staff are friendly and helpful and children enjoy going to school there”
“Communication between teachers and parents is excellent. Extra booster classes after school is a bonus and a great support”
“This school makes sure my child is safe and deals with any worries I have, although I don’t have any worries because this school makes sure that if I do have any concerns they are solved and dealt with”
“Good support is provided to pupils with special needs”
“I personally think this school has everything my children need. They work hard to make sure my children get the best chance of staying at the educational level that all the other children are at. I believe that my children are safe and well treated at this school. I feel I made the best choice in choosing this school”
“I can see a huge difference in my child’s attitude to learning and they really raise standards in social and personal development”
“Good environment, community, atmosphere and activities”
“My own experience with Eastbury Primary has been a great one. My daughter has blossomed so much. Academically I feel the school supports the children, taking time to appreciate each of them individually. As a parent I have been able to communicate with ease with each member of staff so far”

Clubs & Sport
Welcome to the Eastbury Primary Clubs & Sports Page
We are proud to offer after-school clubs each night of the week as well as a daily breakfast club and a variety of activities during lunchtimes.
At the end of their school day, children attending a club go to the hall and can enjoy a healthy snack and a drink if they wish to before they start their extended learning. A special thank you goes to the staff that generously give up their time to run these activities.
We try to ensure our clubs reflect the feedback we receive from children and parents. If you have an idea for a club, please contact our school office and we will consider it when we plan our future provision.
Breakfast Club
The Breakfast club is open everyday from 7:45am until 8:20am. Entry is £2.50 payable in cash at the front office. A variety of activities, games and healthy foods are available for all children who attend.
Eagles Club
We have recently introduced our own After School Provision that runs every Monday to Friday between the hours of 3-6pm. The club offers a variety of activities, games, a light meal and the opportunity to complete homework to all children who attend.
There is a cost of £10.50 per session which must be booked and paid for one week in advance.
If you require any further information or wish to register/book a session, please contact Mrs Kerr at the main office or use the contact.
We’ve entered in the Fun & Active Playgrounds competition and are in with a chance of winning a playground transformation worth £3000! We’re crossing our fingers as the Silver Sports Package includes 6 bright and colourful playground markings that encourage physical play and activity.
With a Netball Court, Dance With Me, Active Trail, Jump Game, Dartboard and 4-Way Hopscotch – the range of markings can be used to enhance breaktimes and PE lessons! Find out more here: https://fun-play.co.uk/playground-competition/

Welcome to Friends of Eastbury Page
Friends of Eastbury
You automatically become a member of the Friends of Eastbury when your child attends Eastbury Primary School. If you would like to help, please come along to any of the meetings and share your ideas and support the group in the next event that will be run, all are welcome. Meetings will be advertised and promoted through the school newsletters and notice boards
The Friends of Eastbury are a parent and teacher association that work for the benefit of the school.
We meet each term to discuss up- coming events to raise money for the school, as well as to arrange fun activities for the children and families to enjoy. These events are organised and run by parents and staff throughout the year. Some of the events arranged are Christmas and Summer Fairs, with stalls that sell cakes, toys and book; games to enjoy and children’s work to buy, as well as film nights with popcorn and many more.
The Friends of Eastbury has a set Constitution which states the guidelines of rules and protocols for the association to follow, so it can run effectively and smoothly. A chairman, treasurer and secretary have been nominated to run the meetings, setting agendas and completing minutes for records.
As part of our meetings we decide where money will be spent that has been raised by the Friends of Eastbury with the support of the school that will benefit the children in different areas of their learning.
If you have any queries please contact the school office: Telephone: 0208 477 9910 (Open from 8am – 4pm) E-mail: office@eps.barking-dagenham.sch.uk
Each Year Father Christmas visits Eastbury Primary School where the children can visit and spend time with him and his helpers enjoying a story and songs, with a personal photo and gift to take home.
